Cindy (AE): FinHealth POC ask: they want a clear acceptance playbook for a 4-week trial. Key asks: p95 latency <= 200ms (in-region), cost <= $0.40 / 1k tokens, eval pass rate >= 92% on 120 labeled prompts, VPC + KMS required, data retention 30d. Can SE/SRE scope burn + runbook? Demo Tues 10am PT.

Olivia (Sales-Eng): I can own the eval suite. Need the prompt set + target distribution (summaries vs classification) and expected concurrency.

Kevin (Solutions): For latency we should run a capped variant + KV cache + batching. Suggest initial config: redwood-rt-13b-quant, KV cache=on, batch_size=8, max_seq=512. We'll do synthetic load to measure p95.

Maria (SRE): Quick capacity calc to help sizing: if avg tokens/request ~300 and target 20 RPS sustained -> 300 * 20 = 6000 tokens/s (~21.6M tokens/hr). For a 4-week pilot rough burn ~150M tokens. That determines Dedicated vs hosted.

Olivia (Sales-Eng): Rough cost @ $0.35 /1k tokens -> 150M tokens = 150k * $0.35 = $52.5k. We can offer $10k trial credit and cap presales at $25k. I'll confirm final offer.

Raj (Product): Proposed acceptance gates: 1) Automated eval (120 prompts) pass rate >= 92% 2) No PII leakage on a 20-case adversarial set 3) p95 latency <=200ms under their expected 95th percentile load 4) total burn <= agreed cap. Add a manual spot-check (10 cases) as final gate.

Olivia (Sales-Eng): Example eval command I'll use to gather generations + latency metrics:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-rt-13b-quant","prompt":"<PROMPT>","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0.0,"stream":false}'
```
We'll log response_time_ms and the full output for automated scoring.

Maria (SRE): Security checklist: they require KMS for key custody, VPC peering, and audit logs. We can enable no-store and retention=30d. For Dedicated in VPC we'll need their CIDR and KMS key ARN to provision.

Kevin (Solutions): Also recommend enabling prefix-caching for system prompts and response deduplication to reduce token burn on identical prompts. I'll prepare canary configs and a test plan.

Cindy (AE): Timeline proposal: Week 1 - ingest prompt corpus & baseline runs; Week 2 - tuning (quant + KV + batching); Week 3 - loadgen & SLA tuning; Week 4 - acceptance, manual spot-checks, and handoff. SE to deliver eval harness by Friday.

Olivia (Sales-Eng): I'll upload the harness to the customer's GH repo and share runbook + sample prompts by EOD Thursday. @Maria can you confirm networking steps and ETA?

Maria (SRE): I'll open an infra ticket and loop in infra-eng. Need customer's CIDR, KMS ARN, and preferred region to proceed.

deploy-bot: presales-canary queued for 2024-03-15T22:00Z

Cindy (AE): Thanks team — action items: Olivia = eval harness & runbook; Maria = infra ticket + KMS; Kevin = canary + test plan; I'll schedule Tues demo and share calendar. Update this thread when items are done :thumbsup:
